entities.name: Peemel
entities.description: Ruler of the city-state of Iwset in the Dark Age of Terisiare, a scheming man killed by his advisor Digody.

entities.name: Lady Edara
entities.description: Lady of Jehesic whom Peemel proposed to, warred against and kidnapped.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A blood witch ordered by Peemel to sow chaos in the north.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Peemel's advisor who stabbed him in the back.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent whose western coast Peemel wanted to control.

events.summary: Peemel proposed marriage to Lady Edara, and when refused, declared war on Jehesic.
events.quote: initially by proposing marriage to Lady Edara

events.summary: Peemel ordered Sacumon to sow chaos in the north, pitting minotaurs against elves.
events.quote: he ordered the blood witch Sacumon to sow chaos in the north

events.summary: After Jehesic captured Ihesia, Peemel counterattacked and kidnapped Lady Edara.
Digody stabbed Peemel in the back, killing him.
events.quote: literally stabbing Lord Peemel in the back

relations.quote: literally stabbing Lord Peemel in the back
Peemel was the ruler of the city-state of Iwset

relations.note: He declared war on her after she refused his proposal.
